welcome.heading: For more than a century, children have climbed this hill to learn.
welcome.intro: Mountain Home School was founded in 1911 by the Women's Home Missionary Society, and it has kept a simple promise ever since: that every child here is known, and cared for, by name.
welcome.body: Our classes are small and our campus is quiet. The day keeps the rhythm of the hills: morning assembly, lessons, games on the red-earth ground, and evenings when the mist rolls in over the tea. Whether your child joins us in LKG or for the ISC years, and whether you are visiting for the first time or coming home after many years, you are welcome here.
